name: Vectra AI
tagline: Vectra AI is a cybersecurity company that uses AI to detect and respond to cyberattacks in real time across hybrid cloud environments. Its Attack Signal Intelligence platform analyzes network traffic, identity, and cloud signals to surface the highest-priority threats before breaches occur.
